## Intake review

**Related:** decision record on #5830 (comment 6719439492); parent design #5677; programme epic #2056.
**Live check:** implementation follow-on filed today so the #5830 decision has a named next action; the issue's own Acceptance section begins this bar — this appended section consolidates it under the standard heading. Implementation timing is a separate decision, per the filing note.
**Notes / risks:** reference-not-content is the invariant everything else hangs on; a shortcut that copies content into posts voids the revocation and pinned-view semantics. Anchor relocation is the subtle part — orphaned is a display state, not an error to auto-repair.
**Suggested approach:** build the reference edge + pinned/live rendering first, then reply anchoring with the three-state resolution, then cross-server grant checks.

— fleet monitor (repo-fleet-monitor), 2026-11-08 10:12 CST run: acceptance criteria appended to the body, labels normalized, `meta/enriched` applied.

- Verdict: REAL AND CURRENT. Issue #7587 is OPEN; the decision it implements is settled (issue #5830 CLOSED, decision record comment 6719439492); no PR references #7587 (GitHub search total_count 0); nothing on current main (62e12a0175) implements the model.
- Evidence at main: pkgs/id/src/boards.rs provides the board-graph substrate (signed board objects, content references, BoardGraph, federation replication) but contains no note-reference post type (object id + home server + pinned version id/content hash + sharer attribution), no live-vs-pinned embed rendering with changed-since-posted indicator, and no reply anchoring to note version/passage with exact/relocated/orphaned states. The pinning hits in boards.rs are thread rules_ref pinning, unrelated.

Acceptance is the end-to-end slice in the issue body, local first, then two-server.
- Blocker / ordering: implementation timing is a separate decision (per issue #5830 filing note, repeated in the #7587 body). No implementation follow-on task is enqueued by this triage: an effort/l, timing-gated implementation claimed now would burn attempts parking. Issue #7587 itself remains the tracked implementation item (it is the implementation issue, under parent #5677 / epic #2056); when Drew sets the timing, phase (1) above is the first claimable slice.
- Triage task 13738 completing as triaged.

🤖 **Agent note** · task 14142 verified — oversized for one task, decomposition recorded, parked
- **Agent:** repo queue worker, lane code-o (repo-worker-code)
- **Session / ID:** cron repo-queue-worker-shift-o run 2026-11-08 21:32 CST; task 14142 (direct lane, row 5415)
- **Fresh verification (this shift):** issue #7587 is OPEN, no hard-stop labels. Decision parent issue #5830 stands closed with its decision record. At origin/main aa01b61853, pkgs/id/src/boards.rs is 3513 lines and contains ZERO matches for NoteRef / note_ref / anchor / embeds / backlink — the packet's "not implemented" evidence is current, and no PR references issue #7587. The work is real and unstarted.
- **Why parked, not built this shift:** the packet is kind small_fix with a 45-minute timebox, but issue #7587's acceptance is a full feature: six invariant areas (reference-not-content posts, dual live/pinned rendering, three-state reply anchoring, graph reference edges + backlinks, grant-checked hash-verified cross-server resolution with announce-and-ack registration, attributed changelog events) plus a two-server end-to-end slice. That is an epic-scale implementation (the issue labels it effort/l), and issue #5830's filing note already called implementation timing a separate decision. A rushed partial slice here would strand half-built invariants; the correct move is decomposition into claimable slices:
  1. **Slice 1 — data model:** NoteRef board-post type (object id, home server, pinned version id + content hash, sharer attribution) + post —embeds→ note edge in the native graph; store/render tests. No content copying.
  2. **Slice 2 — local views + anchoring:** live vs pinned rendering with "changed since posted", reply anchors (version + section/text-range/quote-hash selector) resolving exact / relocated / orphaned; orphaned replies render against the pinned view.
  3. **Slice 3 — backlinks + changelog:** backlink query over the edge store, jump-through parity (human/CLI/API/agent), attributed share/reply/anchor changelog events; sharing grants no edit rights, creates no fork (negative tests).
  4. **Slice 4 — cross-server:** grant-checked, hash-verified resolution; render-only version-labelled board-side cache honouring revocation on refresh; announce-and-ack backlink registration with retry; failed announcement never blocks posting; two-server E2E per acceptance.
- **Expectation:** park 1200s. Resume condition: slice 1 filed/claimed as its own task (or a design-mill intake per the fleet's large-work route); task 14142 then tracks the remaining slices instead of pretending one 45-minute claim can land the whole model.
- **Links:** task 14142 · issue #7587 · issue #5830 · issue #5677 · issue #2056
